raw.query: WITH m AS (SELECT n_images, mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_fn WHERE image_px=448 AND engine='measured_5x50' AND n_images<=64), a AS (SELECT n_images, aic_ms FROM provenance.collector_fn WHERE image_px=448 AND engine='aic_postinfill' AND n_images<=64), r AS (SELECT m.n_images, m.mean_ms/a.aic_ms AS ratio FROM m JOIN a USING (n_images)) SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(ratio) min_ratio, MAX(ratio) max_ratio, AVG(ratio) mean_ratio, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio < 1.4) below_1_4, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio > 1.6) above_1_6 FROM r;
raw.evidence: Both claimed bounds breached on the standard 448px N<=64 sweep (the 'same range' in THESIS-MAP): 3 of 6 ratios fall below the 1.4 floor and 1 of 6 exceeds the 1.6 ceiling; measured span 1.36-1.62, not 1.4-1.6.
